The goal here is to walk through some basic steps for data tidying, analysis, and plotting.
For your analyses, please don't edit this DEMO script, but feel free to copy/paste anything in this into your own analysis script(s)

I will be using the ROMO PICO overstory tree data for this demo but everything should be adaptable to explore the other PICO datasets 

# 1. Data Tidying
This is usually the most time consuming and important step of analyzing data in R. I like to do most of this using the 'dplyr' package/'tidyverse' but most can also be done in Base R. If there is a particular transformation or re-structuring of the data that you are trying to accomplish but just can't figure it out, ChatGPT is really helpful for this

```{r}
#Load Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Load Data
TreeData <- read.csv("PICO_Data/ROMO_PICO_TreeData.csv")
TreeReport <- read.csv("PICO_Data/ROMO_PICO_TreesReport.csv")

## 1. Tidying 'TreeData': remove unnecessary columns, rename variables, create other useful metrics

# Remove unnecessary columns: (use 'select' to only keep columns of interest). *Tip: enter 'print(colnames(TreeData))' into console to view column names without having to open the dataframe*
TreeData <- TreeData %>% select(MacroPlot.Name, Sample.Event.Date, Quarter, Tag.Num., Species, Status, Crown.Class, DBH, Height, 
                                Live.Crown.Base.Ht., UV3, Damage.1, Damage.2, Damage.3, Damage.4, Damage.5, Char.Ht., Scorch.Ht.,
                                Crown.Scorch.., Plot.Area, Snag.Plot.Area, Break.Pnt..Dia., Comment.y)

# Change 'MacroPlot.Name' to 'PlotID' and re-format 'FPICO1T08:09' naming convention to be more streamlined
TreeData <- TreeData %>% rename(PlotID = MacroPlot.Name) %>%  mutate(PlotID = str_replace(PlotID, "^F", ""),  
    PlotID = str_replace(PlotID, "1T\\d{2}:(\\d{2})", "_\\1"))

# Add in a column for Treatment Status 
#First, create a new dataframe with the treatment statuses 
StatusTable <- TreeData %>% select(PlotID, Sample.Event.Date) %>% distinct() %>% arrange(PlotID)
StatusTable <- StatusTable %>% mutate(MonStatus = c("02Year05", "00Pre", "01Year01", "01Year02", "01Year05", 
                                                    "02Year05", "00Pre", "01Year01", "01Year02", "01Year05", 
                                                    "02Year05", "00Pre", "01Year01", "01Year02", "01Year05", 
                                                    "01Year05", "00Pre", "02Year05", "00Pre", "01Year01", "01Year02", "01Year05", 
                                                    "01Year05", "00Pre", "01Year05", "00Pre", "01Year05", "00Pre", "01Year05", "00Pre", 
                                                    "01Year05", "00Pre", "01Year05", "00Pre", "01Year05", "00Pre", "01Year05", "00Pre",
                                                    "01Year05", "00Pre"))
TreeData <- left_join(StatusTable, TreeData)

# Add a column for whether plot burned in East Troublesome
TreeData <- TreeData %>% mutate(Burned2020 = case_when(PlotID == "PICO_08" & MonStatus == "02Year05" ~ "no",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_09" & MonStatus == "02Year05" ~ "no",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_10" & MonStatus == "02Year05" ~ "yes",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_11" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "yes",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_12" & MonStatus == "02Year05" ~ "yes",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_13" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "yes",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_14" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "yes",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_15" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "no",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_16" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "yes",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_19" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "no",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_20" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "yes",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_21" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "no",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_24" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "no",
                                                       PlotID == "PICO_24" & MonStatus == "01Year05" ~ "no", .default = NA))


# to be continued...





```
